title: Lackluster & Lame
text:
Lackluster & Lame. These were incredibly... lackluster.
I was so disappointed in them. They had to be shook very hard and each tube had way less confetti than I expected from the photos. I wouldn't waste your money on these. You are better off shredding white paper and throwing it in the air than spending on these.
